spans.s: The object of the verb कृ takes the 6th-Case-affix, when it means 'to impart a new quality or virtue' -- गन्धनावक्षेपणसेवनसाहसिक्यप्रतियत्नप्रकथनोपयोगेषु कृञः

After a verb which ends with आम् , the verb कृ 'to do', is annexed when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows.

Terms: आम्

The affix ट comes after the verb कृञ् 'to make' when the object is in composition with it denoting cause, habit and going with the grain (concession).

Terms: ट

And after the root कृ comes the affix श in forming a feminine as well as the affix क्यप्‌।

Terms: क्यप्‌

The affix डाच् comes after the word 1. द्वितीय 2. तृतीय 3. शम्ब and 4. बीज when connected with the verb कृ 'to make' and meaning 'to plough in such a way'.

Terms: डाच्
